components.css: .ds-path{width:min(100%,640px);min-height:440px;position:relative;display:block;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;background:var(--ink,#1d1d1a);text-decoration:none}.ds-path-photo{height:54%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted,#6b665e);background:var(--stone,#d8d0c4);font:600 10px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:transform 700ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-path-copy{position:absolute;right:36px;bottom:36px;left:36px}.ds-path-copy h2{margin:0 0 8px;font:500 clamp(2.5rem,4vw,4.2rem)/.95 'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-path-copy p{max-width:44ch;margin:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);font:400 14px/1.55 'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-path-action{position:absolute;z-index:2;top:24px;right:24px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 13px;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1a);background:rgba(250,247,240,.94);font:600 12px 'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-path-action svg{transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-path:hover .ds-path-photo{transform:scale(1.035)}.ds-path:hover .ds-path-action svg{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}.ds-path:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#805139);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-destination{width:min(100%,360px);position:relative;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1a);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-destination-photo{aspect-ratio:4/5;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;color:var(--muted,#6b665e);background:var(--stone,#d8d0c4);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:transform 650ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-destination-body{min-height:100px;padding:16px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#1d1d1a)}.ds-destination h3{margin:0;font:500 30px/1 'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.02em;transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-destination p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#6b665e);font-size:12px}.ds-destination-body>span{color:var(--muted,#6b665e);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-save{width:44px;height:44px;position:absolute;z-index:2;top:12px;right:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:50%;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1a);background:rgba(250,247,240,.94);cursor:pointer;transition:background 200ms ease,transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-destination:hover .ds-destination-photo{transform:scale(1.028)}.ds-destination:hover h3{transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-save:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#fff}.ds-save:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#805139);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: WhereTo opens like a carefully art-directed travel magazine rather than a startup dashboard. Warm paper, charcoal type, and asymmetrical photography create calm editorial tension; a compact question and a contact-sheet hero let real places establish desire before the interface asks the traveler to choose a path. The system stays useful beneath that atmosphere. Discovery, destination search, saved places, attraction details, and the illustrative map all share the same flat paper-and-ink grammar. Cormorant Garamond carries place and emotion, DM Sans carries action and information, and hairline rules organize content without enclosing every idea in a card.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory paper with deep ink and quiet earth neutrals.
Self-hosted Cormorant Garamond display type paired with self-hosted DM Sans utility text.
An asymmetrical, photography-led contact sheet in the first viewport.
Square, borderless image fields and hairline-divided content structures.
Photo-led path cards, destination cards, recommendations, and saved-place stories.
Subtle page and image reveals with complete reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Paper Is the Canvas Rule
rules.body: Warm ivory remains visually continuous across a route; use borders, spacing, and photography before introducing another surface.

rules.name: The Photograph Owns the Color Rule
rules.body: Let destination imagery provide saturation. Interface hues stay muted and functional.

rules.name: The Two Editorial Voices Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond names places and frames stories; DM Sans explains, labels, and enables action.

rules.name: The Serif Earns Its Scale Rule
rules.body: Large serif type appears only where a destination, question, or story deserves focus. Do not use it as ornamental filler.

rules.name: The Contact Sheet Rule
rules.body: Asymmetry must still read as composed: one dominant photograph, clear supporting crops, shared edges, and narrow consistent gutters.

rules.name: The Story Before Inventory Rule
rules.body: Discovery surfaces lead with place, feeling, and the two traveler intents before exposing the larger destination set.

rules.name: The Mobile Continuity Rule
rules.body: Collapse the composition, not the story. Preserve the heading, all three hero images, both paths, useful state, and primary navigation.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface is readable with a hairline, tonal shift, or image edge, it does not receive a shadow.

rules.name: The Square-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Begin at 0px. Use 2px only to soften a control edge, 8px only where directional map geometry needs it, and 50% only for genuinely circular controls or markers.

rules.name: The Shared Selection Rule
rules.body: Attraction rows, numbered pins, and the map preview must always describe the same selected place.

dos: Do let real destination photography establish mood and provide the page's strongest color.
Do compose asymmetrical image groups with a clear dominant crop, aligned edges, and narrow consistent gutters.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for questions, place names, and editorial story headings, and DM Sans for everything operational.
Do use warm ivory as the continuous canvas and hairline rules as the primary grouping device.
Do preserve the square 0px geometry, using 2px controls and true circles only for the documented exceptions.
Do synchronize attraction-row, map-pin, and preview selection state.
Do keep page entry and image reveals subtle, and reduce all nonessential animation to effectively zero when reduced motion is requested.
Do preserve discovery, search, saved, attraction-detail, and illustrative-map flows as the visual system expands.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, neon color, or decorative geometric flourishes.
Don't turn every section into a card or every action into a pill.
Don't introduce generous rounding; 8px is a selective map-geometry exception, not a general card radius.
Don't add resting shadows to paths, destinations, recommendations, attraction rows, detail panels, or saved stories.
Don't replace photography with abstract illustration when a place image can carry the story.
Don't make filters, map metadata, or secondary facts compete with the editorial title and the route's next task.
Don't turn WhereTo into a booking dashboard or remove content and state to simplify mobile layouts.
